commentary_title: New US sanctions on Russia push up freight rates
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index increased to 97.3 in week 43, continuing to rise from the previous week. While market activity in the Aframax market started slowly, it picked up pace by the end of the week, supporting freight rates. | The ballast and laden speeds in the West declined last week, but an uptick was observed towards the East. The %laden tonnage is expected to increase next week, resulting in more tonnage underway. | The US has imposed new sanctions on Russia's largest oil producers, which is expected to result in continued firmness in freight rates over the next week.
